messages:
auditor_chloe: Hi team — auditor asks for an evidence package for INCT-2026-05: timeline, CloudTrail/KMS usage (decrypt/encrypt), RBAC delta, and chain-of-custody for exported artifacts. What can you provide and ETA?

samir_security: We can assemble that. ETA initial export: EOD tomorrow. Will include CloudTrail slice, raw KMS events, RBAC commit diffs, signed manifest, and file hashes.

auditor_chloe: For chain-of-custody we need who handled each artifact and verifiable signatures. Preserve original object timestamps.

alex_ops: I'll export CloudTrail + KMS logs for window 2026-05-14T02:00Z to 2026-05-14T04:00Z, upload to s3://redwood-audit-exports/inct-2026-05/, generate sha256 per file and sign with my GPG key. Example I will include: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-05-14T02:00:00Z --end-time 2026-05-14T04:00:00Z > ct-window.json; sha256sum ct-window.json > ct-window.sha256; gpg --default-key 0xA1B2C3D4 --sign ct-window.sha256. I'll supply presigned S3 links to the auditor.

maya_oncall: RBAC: I captured k8s audit logs and infra repo history for infra/roles. I'll include git log/diff for rolebindings and an exported k8s audit slice for namespace inference-prod. Also captured CI job id that granted elevated perms and will attach the job log + PR ref.

security-bot: Incident INCT-2026-05 status -> evidence_export_in_progress by @alex_ops (INC-8942).

auditor_chloe: Please include raw KMS event payloads including keyId and callerIdentity, and key rotation history for involved CMKs (last 90 days).

samir_security: We'll add a CSV mapping eventId,keyId,principal,operation and a small verification script that checks sha256s against the signed manifest.

auditor_chloe: For RBAC provide a CSV: principal, previous_role, new_role, timestamp, commit_sha, reviewed(Boolean). Helps map to SOC2 controls.

alex_ops: Noted. We'll provide redacted and unredacted artifacts (unredacted under NDA). Redaction process will be documented in the manifest.

maya_oncall: Root cause: CI job temporarily created a service account with edit perms; PR #3421 is the change — I'll flag that in the manifest and include the job log.

samir_security: Action items: Alex — CloudTrail/KMS export, sha256s, GPG sigs, presigned links. Maya — RBAC diffs, k8s audit slice, CI logs. Samir — chain-of-custody manifest, verification script, control-mapping doc mapping artifacts to SOC2/ISO controls.

auditor_chloe: Thanks. Ping when links are ready and include a short narrated timeline (bulleted) linking action -> effect to speed review. :+1:
